title: City planner reviewing university lab expansion in INS
description: Senior planner triaging a proposed lab/research building addition on an institutional campus
notes: Tests INS use permissions for research/laboratory uses, dimensional standards in an institutional zone, and how the bylaw handles campus-style master sites. Underrepresented zone.

address: Halifax Common, North Park Street side, Halifax, NS
title: Lawyer advising adjoining owner on RPK encroachment risk
description: Real-estate lawyer fielding a question about a deck that may overhang into an RPK-zoned park parcel
notes: Tests RPK permitted/accessory uses and what the bylaw says (or doesn't say) about private encroachments into park-zoned land. Underrepresented zone.

title: Architect scoping a mid-rise residential infill in HR-2
description: Architect doing a feasibility study on a 6–8 storey residential infill
notes: Tests HR-2 FAR, height overlay map (precincts), streetwall + stepback requirements, and parking minimums. Spring Garden corridor is heavily overlaid.

title: Developer chasing bonus density in CEN-2
description: Developer exploring bonus zoning provisions to push height and FAR above as-of-right
notes: Tests CEN-2 base FAR/height, bonus-zoning trigger menu, ground-floor active-use requirement, and streetwall standards. Adversarial — user pushes for max possible scenario and assumes bonuses are stackable.

title: Developer pricing a DH heritage retention infill
description: Developer pricing the cost of building behind a retained facade in DH
notes: Tests Downtown Halifax heritage demolition/retention rules, viewplanes, height precincts, and what triggers heritage review. Adversarial — user asks if they can demolish if facade is structurally unsound.

title: Realtor due-diligence on a DD listing
description: Realtor preparing a marketing package for a downtown Dartmouth property
notes: Tests Downtown Dartmouth use permissions, ground-floor active-use requirements, and base height standards. Underrepresented use case.

title: Homeowner expanding a legally non-conforming duplex in ER-1
description: Owner of a duplex predating current ER-1 zoning that only permits single-unit dwellings
notes: Adversarial. Tests how the bylaw treats expansion of a legally non-conforming use and whether the homeowner can add a third unit or just renovate within existing footprint. Easy to hallucinate permission here.

title: Developer scoping a transit-oriented infill on a COR corridor site
description: Developer evaluating a 5–7 storey mixed-use building near a major bus terminal
notes: Tests COR corridor standards: height precincts along corridors, ground-floor use, parking reductions near transit. Adversarial — user asks about reducing parking based on transit proximity.

title: Homeowner planning a backyard suite in ER-3
description: Owner of a single-unit lot adding a detached backyard suite over a garage
notes: Tests backyard suite provisions specifically — separate from secondary suite rules. Often confused. Confirms model distinguishes between the two.

title: Planner reviewing site plan approval for HR-1 mid-rise near a viewplane
description: Senior planner triaging an application that may impinge on a protected viewplane
notes: Tests viewplane mapping, height limits derived from viewplanes (not just zone), site-plan-approval triggers, shadow impact. High liability — easy to miss the viewplane constraint.
